title: Oregon vs Washington State

segments.summary: Washington State player #32 catches a pass and runs for a touchdown against Oregon early in the first quarter.
events: The ball is snapped to begin a play for Washington State.
Washington State player #32 catches a short pass and turns upfield.
Washington State player #32 runs past several Oregon defenders into the end zone.
The referee signals a touchdown for Washington State.

segments.summary: Washington State takes a 6-0 lead over Oregon early in the first quarter. Following the touchdown, Washington State kicks off to Oregon, who returns the ball to the 25-yard line.
events: Washington State players celebrate their touchdown in the end zone.
The Washington State head coach is shown watching from the sidelines.
Washington State kicks off to Oregon.
Oregon player #16 returns the kickoff to the 25-yard line before being tackled.

segments.summary: Replay footage of the game's opening touchdown shows Washington State's quarterback finding player #32 for a short pass, who then dodges several defenders to score. The point after is successful, making the score 7-0.
events: Washington State player #16 completes a short screen pass to player #32.
Washington State player #32 maneuvers past a diving tackle attempt by Oregon player #15.
Washington State player #32 breaks a tackle attempt from Oregon player #35.
Washington State player #32 stiff-arms Oregon player #39 and runs into the end zone.
A graphics overlay shows the score as 7-0 in favor of Washington State with 12:43 remaining in the first quarter.

segments.summary: At the start of the second quarter, Washington State leads 7-0. Quarterback Minshew II completes a pass to a teammate as they look to extend their lead.
events: The second quarter begins with Washington State holding a 7-0 lead over Oregon.
Washington State quarterback #16 completes a pass for a gain of over 10 yards.

segments.summary: Washington State quarterback Minshew II completes a long pass to player #21, who runs down the left sideline for a significant gain.
events: Washington State lines up for a 2nd and 9 play from their own side of the field.
Minshew II takes the snap and drops back to pass.
Minshew II throws a pass towards the left sideline.
Washington State player #21 catches the ball and sprints past the Oregon secondary.

segments.summary: Washington State player #21 scores a touchdown, which is upheld after a formal review, bringing the score to 13-0.
events: Washington State player #21 crosses the goal line for a touchdown.
Referees conduct an official review of the play to check if the player's knee touched the ground before the goal line.
The head referee announces the ruling that the touchdown stands.
Washington State players celebrate on the sideline after the confirmation.

segments.summary: Washington State increases their lead to 19-0 after quarterback Minshew II throws a touchdown pass to Winston Jr. in the end zone.
events: Washington State lines up for a 3rd and goal play.
Minshew II passes the ball to Winston Jr., who catches it for a touchdown.
Winston Jr. and Martin Jr. celebrate the scoring play in the end zone.

segments.summary: Washington State increases their dominant lead over Oregon as Minshew II throws his second touchdown pass of the game to Tay Martin.
events: Washington State converts an extra point to bring the score to 20-0.
Minshew II completes a touchdown pass to Tay Martin.
The score updates to 26-0 in favor of Washington State late in the second quarter.

segments.summary: Oregon scores their first points of the game in the third quarter with a touchdown pass from Justin Herbert to Jaylon Redd.
events: Oregon lines up for a 4th and 1 play at the Washington State goal line.
Quarterback Justin Herbert throws a short pass to Jaylon Redd in the end zone for a touchdown.
The Oregon offense celebrates their first touchdown of the game.

segments.summary: Oregon cuts into Washington State's lead with a touchdown pass from Justin Herbert to Jaylon Redd.
events: Justin Herbert completes a long pass to Jaylon Redd.
Jaylon Redd runs into the end zone for a touchdown.
Oregon players celebrate the score.

segments.summary: Washington State extends their lead in the fourth quarter with a touchdown pass from Minshew II to James Williams.
events: Minshew II throws a short pass to Williams.
Williams runs the ball into the end zone for a touchdown.
The Washington State team celebrates the touchdown in the end zone.
The scoreboard updates to show Washington State leading Oregon 33-20.

segments.summary: Washington State seals a 34-20 victory over Oregon, as players and coaches celebrate their fourth consecutive win against the Ducks.
events: Washington State players celebrate on the field after a scoring play.
The game clock winds down to zero, confirming a 34-20 win for Washington State.
Minshew II and teammates embrace to celebrate the victory.

segments.summary: Washington State fans storm the field at Martin Stadium to celebrate their victory over Oregon. Gardner Minshew II is seen with blood on his face during the post-game celebration, while Justin Herbert walks across the field.
events: Fans jump over the railings and storm the field to celebrate.
Gardner Minshew II celebrates with T. Harris and other teammates on the field.
Justin Herbert walks through the crowd on the field with a towel around his neck.

segments.summary: Fireworks celebrate the victory at Martin Stadium at night, followed by a Fox Sports end screen.
events: Red fireworks erupt from a building at Martin Stadium.
The video transitions to a Fox Sports logo animation.

rules: The offence has four attempts, called downs, to move the ball 10 yards; reaching them resets the count to first down.
On fourth down a team usually punts the ball away or tries a field goal rather than risk handing possession over where they stand.
A touchdown is worth 6 points, the extra-point kick after it 1, a two-point conversion 2, a field goal 3, a safety 2 for the defence.
The play ends when the ball carrier is tackled to the ground, steps out of bounds, or the pass falls incomplete.
An incomplete pass stops the clock; a run or a completed pass inside the field keeps it running.
False start: an offensive player moves before the snap. Five yards, and the play is blown dead before it begins.
Offside / encroachment: a defender is in or across the neutral zone at the snap. Five yards.
Holding by the offence: grabbing or hooking a defender who is not carrying the ball. Ten yards, and it often wipes out a big gain.
Defensive holding or illegal contact: restraining a receiver early in the route. Five yards and usually an automatic first down.
Pass interference: significant contact that stops a receiver playing a catchable ball. The offence gets the ball where the foul happened; on the defence it is an automatic first down.
Roughing the passer: hitting the quarterback late, in the head, or driving him into the ground. Fifteen yards and an automatic first down.
Targeting: a hit with the crown of the helmet or to a defenceless player's head. Fifteen yards, and in college the player is ejected.
Unsportsmanlike conduct or taunting: fifteen yards, enforced from where the previous play ended.
Delay of game: the play clock runs out before the snap. Five yards.
Intentional grounding: the quarterback throws the ball away from any receiver while under pressure inside the pocket. Loss of down and yardage.
A turnover means the other team takes possession: an interception is a pass caught by the defence, a fumble is a loose ball recovered by either side.
A yellow flag on the field means an official saw a foul; the referee then announces it and the penalty yardage is walked off.
Coaches may challenge some calls, and scoring plays and turnovers are reviewed automatically by a booth official.
College football differs from the NFL: one foot in bounds completes a catch, the clock stops briefly after a first down, and overtime is played from the opponent's 25-yard line.
